data: 100% synthetic, generated by the JalSakhi village simulator
status: Proof of concept. Not validated on field data.

branch_anomaly.algorithm: Calibrated head-loss curve + lane demand profile; CUSUM on the pressure residual raises the alarm, Isolation Forest (140 trees) scores how unusual the lane looks
features: pressure residual vs learned head-loss curve (z)
branch_anomaly.train_scope: 3 simulated normal days x 6 villages (31 lanes); alarm level set on 2 further days

was.method: Isolation Forest score and residual over threshold for 8 readings in a row

branch_anomaly.alert_rule: CUSUM of the residual (allowance 1.0 sigma, at most 3.5 sigma per reading) reaches 9: at least 4 readings of evidence, so a short transient cannot trip it

fault_classifier.algorithm: Histogram gradient-boosted trees (70 iterations, depth 3) on the residual pattern along the lane

was.method: rule: flow 2.0 sigma above demand = leak, within 0.5 sigma = obstruction, else undetermined

fault_classifier.split: faults in VLG-DK, VLG-AG are never trained on; test faults use other days and sizes everywhere

leak_locator.algorithm: Weighted least-squares fit of the leak signature (loss ramps up to the leak, flat beyond) to the mean residual at every measured point; obstructions are bracketed between two points

was.method: latest reading against an assumed friction profile; reports the segment between two sensors

leak_locator.note: A leak before the first metered tap can only be placed 'before that tap'.

pump_failure_risk.target: pump reaches failure condition within the next 72 run-hours
pump_failure_risk.split: by pump: 80% of synthetic pumps train, 20% held out
pump_failure_risk.tried_and_dropped: isotonic calibration of the probability: no gain on held-out pumps (Brier score unchanged), so it is not used

pump_remaining_life.algorithm: Wear index (linear, from current, vibration and discharge) extrapolated along the pump's own trend; quantile gradient boosting on fleet histories when the trend is not yet clear
pump_remaining_life.evaluated_on: 4752 readings in the last 300 run-hours of held-out pumps

was.method: no remaining-life estimate: only the 72-hour risk

pump_remaining_life.note: Synthetic pumps wear in a straight line, which flatters trend extrapolation; the own-trend interval is never narrower than -30% / +40% for that reason. The demo's 'pump wearing out' scenario wears the pump far faster than the fleet histories, which is why the estimate follows the pump's own trend first.

complaint_classifier.algorithm: TF-IDF character n-grams (1-4) + multinomial logistic regression
complaint_classifier.split: 5-fold cross-validation over whole seed phrases: every phrase is tested once by a model that never saw it or a variant of it

was.method: same model with only the first 411 phrases to learn from

complaint_classifier.reading: More phrases helped on the first batch (each phrase held out in turn) and not on the newer batch, which the earlier model already handled about as well without having seen it.
complaint_classifier.tried_and_dropped: adding word n-grams and cross-word character n-grams, and a linear SVM: within one point of this model under the same folds, so the simpler one is kept. The gain came from more varied phrases.

sensor_study.method: the detection benchmark's fault cases, re-scored with different numbers of metered taps per lane; lane entry and tail sensors are present in every option
sensor_study.note: Simulated. 'Affected' means a home truly below usable pressure at that moment, a few minutes into the fault. Every home on the lane is counted in every option, whether its status is measured or inferred.

limits: Trained and evaluated only on simulator output; the simulator's physics is simpler than a real network.
Injected faults are clean single faults; real faults overlap, drift and coincide with sensor errors.
The leak locator assumes the shape the simulator gives a leak (loss ramps up to it, flat beyond). Real pipes follow the same physics less tidily, and the position error will be larger.
Pump histories are synthetic run-to-failure curves, not real maintenance records.
Complaint classifier is trained on a few hundred hand-written phrases, not real grievance text.
Field use needs authorised historical data, time-split validation and a pilot calibration period.
